label: The Storyteller
tagline: An engine that lets a storyteller hear their own pacing without a mirror.
cluster_explainer: The Storyteller spans auditor and practitioner — they read the engine as a diagnostic breath under a telling and refuse any tool that would impose a story-shaped template.
demo_highlights: Icosahedron's 20 faces read as nested beats — a visible top-of-arc and a visible resolution, all in one object the eye can hold.
Mid-band coupling tracks the vocal chest where story tension lives, not the kick drum or the cymbal wash.
Hallucination preset holds a narrative palette: dramatic without becoming illustration — the listener still hears the teller.
Smooth envelope (0.7) makes the engine follow a storyteller's breath-in / breath-out pacing rather than snapping to transient hits.
Long loop (90s) lets one telling breathe end-to-end; the engine waits for the arc instead of resetting the room every chorus.
